variants.specifics: Brackenford: A townsman points the player to Halvard in the Moot Hall, who sends him up Crow Hill after Red Corwin.

herald.speaker: Townsman
herald.text: Halvard is looking for someone brave! Hurry! The Moot Hall is just up the road!

opening.speaker: Halvard
opening.text:
Ah, at last! Someone who isn't afraid to walk the roads!

That villain Red Corwin and his bandits have seized the old watchtower on Crow Hill, north of town. They rob every cart and traveler on the north road, and I have had no choice but to shut the north gate. Brackenford cannot live long without its trade!

Go up Crow Hill and drive Corwin out of that tower. I will tell Garrick to open the gate for you. Off with you, lad, and good luck!

reminder.speaker: Halvard
reminder.text: Wanderer! Get up that hill at once!

journal.text: Go to the watchtower on Crow Hill and defeat Red Corwin.

variants.specifics: Krennack: A townsman points the player to Foreman Brakkus at the Pit Office, who sends him down the old service tunnel after Urgrubb's Ogres at the Great Lift.

herald.speaker: Gant
herald.text: Those Ogres never would have taken the Great Lift if Foreman Brakkus had been on the lever! Go and find him at the Pit Office.

opening.speaker: Brakkus
opening.text:
Ah, there you are! Corvane said you'd be along. Good. We need you, lad.

Urgrubb and his Ogres came up out of the deep tunnels and seized the Great Lift! We can't get ore up or food down, and the whole town is going hungry!

Take this key. It opens the old service tunnel at the south end of the Pit. Get down to the Great Lift and drive Urgrubb out. Krennack is counting on you!

reminder.speaker: Brakkus
reminder.text: Oi! Hello!? This is a mine office, not an inn. Shouldn't you be at the Lift?

journal.text: Foreman Brakkus has given you the service tunnel key, but Urgrubb's Ogres still hold the Great Lift. Maybe the old tunnel is another way down...

variants.specifics: Skell: Wendle points the player to Mayor Pellum, who gives him the key to the Sunken Temple and sends him after Vashtor. Orvel sent the player.

herald.speaker: Wendle
herald.text: Something wicked is creeping out of the swamp! Has Mayor Pellum found anybody brave enough to stop it?

opening.speaker: Mayor Pellum
opening.text:
Ah, there you are, lad! Orvel wrote that he was sending someone. Not a moment too soon!

The Necromancer Vashtor has taken the Sunken Temple east of Skell. Every night his Zombies climb out of the water and come knocking at our doors. Nobody sleeps and nobody fishes!

Here is the key to the temple gate. Go in, find Vashtor and put an end to his wickedness. All of Skell is counting on you!

reminder.speaker: Mayor Pellum
reminder.text: I have nothing more to give you just now. Good luck with Vashtor. His Zombies can be slow and stubborn bunch.

journal.text: New quest! Find Vashtor in the Sunken Temple!

variants.specifics: Varrok: Pellam sends the player to Warden Grisholm in the Keep; the Warden, an old friend of the patron Dorran, sends him through the east postern to take Grukk's fort at the Stone Bridge.

herald.speaker: Pellam
herald.text: That's it! First they take the bridge then they starve us out. Go see Warden Grisholm in the Keep!

opening.speaker: Grisholm
opening.text:
So, Dorran's friend has finally arrived! Good. We have no time to lose.

That brute Grukk and his Ogres have taken the old fort at the Stone Bridge, east of the castle. Not a single wagon gets through, and my men are down to their last crust of bread! This insolent usurper must be stopped!

I've ordered the east postern unbarred for you. Cross the bridge, take that fort and bring me Grukk's head, lad. Go!

reminder.speaker: Grisholm
reminder.text: It's open! The postern's open! Er... After you.

journal.text: Find a way into Grukk's fort at the Stone Bridge.

variants.specifics: Kesk: Fennic points the player to Mayor Hobbrig, who sends him to Gull Island to stop the Necromancer Skarn.

herald.speaker: Fennic
herald.text: You must see Mayor Hobbrig before the sun goes down. Our village must not fall to those walking dead!

opening.speaker: Hobbrig
opening.text:
Ah! You must be the one Tolbek sent! At last!

A Necromancer named Skarn has taken the old keep on Gull Island. Every night he calls our drowned fishermen up out of the lake and sends them shambling into Kesk! It is a horror beyond words!

You must go to the island and put an end to this madness. Bodrik keeps the boats down at the docks. Hurry, lad -- before the sun goes down again!

reminder.speaker: Hobbrig
reminder.text: The island? Get a boat from the docks and row straight out toward the keep..

journal.text: Find a boat to Gull Island and defeat Skarn.

variants.specifics: Ostrel: Dilly points the player to Arch-Mage Tollund in the Great Library, who gives him the key to the South Gate and sends him after Malgrin.

herald.speaker: Dilly
herald.text: Oh, hello. Arch-Mage Tollund is in the Great Library.

opening.speaker: Tollund
opening.text:
Ah, there you are! Vandell's letter said you'd be coming. He speaks highly of you, lad. I hope he's right.

Bad times have come to Ostrel. Malgrin -- a wizard we threw out of this College long ago -- has gathered an army of Ogres in the Gloomfen. They've already cut the fen road. Next it will be our gates!

Take this key. It opens the South Gate. Go through the Gloomfen, find Malgrin's Tower and stop him. The fate of the whole College rests on your shoulders!

journal.text: Put an end to Malgrin and his Ogres!

variants.specifics: Ulmgard: Pell points the newcomer to Warden Galmor, who gives the Upper Gate key and sends him after Ostrag the Necromancer in the Glacier Tombs.

herald.speaker: Pell
herald.text: Warden Galmor has bolted the Upper Gate until someone drives the Undead off the pass. I hope Master Dromund sent us somebody useful. The Warden usually just shouts at them from the wall instead of fighting them.

opening.speaker: Galmor
opening.text:
Ah! You must be the one Dromund promised me. Good! I need every pair of hands I can get.

The Necromancer Ostrag has raised the dead in the Glacier Tombs above the pass. His Undead swarm the high road and not a single sled has come through. I fear he means to take this fort next!

Here is the key to the Upper Gate. Go up through the gate, find Ostrag in the Tombs and put an end to him, lad. All of Ulmgard is counting on you.

journal.text: Seek out Ostrag the Necromancer in the Glacier Tombs above the Upper Gate.

variants.specifics: Kalgarr: Brix points the player to Forgemaster Hadric, an old friend of Mardock's, who hands over the key to the Mine Gate and sends him after Malgrith in the Deep Furnace.

herald.speaker: Brix
herald.text: That crazed fire witch has set the mines ablaze. Find Forgemaster Hadric in the Forge Hall before she does worse.

opening.speaker: Hadric
opening.text:
So you're the one Mardock sent! Good. You've arrived not a moment too soon, lad.

Malgrith the Fire Witch has seized the Deep Furnace beneath Mount Skarl. Her Ember Demons pour out of it day and night, and not one cart of ore has come up the mine road since!

Take this key. It opens the Mine Gate at the north end of town. Go down into the Deep Furnace and stop Malgrith -- before she melts all of Kalgarr down to slag!

reminder.speaker: Hadric
reminder.text: The Mine Gate holds fast against most, lad. But turn my key in its lock and the road down is yours!

journal.text: Defeat Malgrith the Fire Witch in the Deep Furnace

variants.specifics: Torvel: Mirra points the player to Mayor Dremmel in the Toll House, who sends him against Skarn's bandits in Varga Tower.

herald.speaker: Mirra
herald.text: My, my! You're a sight better looking than the bandits! Go see Mayor Dremmel at the Toll House, and come back to me in one piece.

opening.speaker: Dremmel
opening.text:
Ah! You must be the one Ulbar wrote to me about. Good, good. You have arrived not a moment too soon!

That villain Skarn and his bandits have seized Varga Tower, on the hill north of town. They have shut the road to Kelmor! Not one wagon has come through in weeks, and Torvel cannot live without that road.

You must go up to the tower and drive Skarn out. Take this key to the north gate. Brask will let you pass. Good luck, lad. All of Torvel is counting on you!

journal.text: Go up to Varga Tower and defeat the bandit Skarn.

variants.writer: Claude Agent SDK subagent, Claude Opus 5.5 (claude-opus-5-5)

variants.specifics: Durnhal: Bessa points the player to Mayor Quillon at the Town Hall; Garamund sent the player; Ugrash's Ogres hold the Stone Granary and the town's grain.

herald.speaker: Bessa
herald.text: Hello there. Has Mayor Quillon found you at the Town Hall, yet?

opening.speaker: Quillon
opening.text:
Ah, at last! Garamund wrote that he would send someone.

It is a dark hour for Durnhal, lad. Ugrash the Ogre Chief and his horde have seized the Stone Granary on the hill north of town, with every sack of our grain inside! That Ogre is a greater calamity than locusts and hail together!

Take this key. It opens the north gate. Drive Ugrash out of the Granary or Durnhal will starve this winter. Good luck!

reminder.speaker: Quillon
reminder.text: Why are you still dawdling? Save our grain!

journal.text: Drive Ugrash and his Ogres from the Stone Granary.
